title: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
author: Anthropic
description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
summary: We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API. For the first time, the discount applies across every product surface, including when agencies buy from us directly today and through cloud providers in the coming months.
takeaways: Claude for Government, which delivers Claude's coding and agentic work capabilities and provides near-feature parity with commercial offerings at a FedRAMP High authorization level, was made generally available on September 30.
We are also launching a dedicated program to help agencies implement and make the most of their Claude use.
These programs are commonly leveraged by our private sector customers and we’re looking forward to bringing those best practices to our public sector partners in the coming weeks.
